periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis is vertically oriented with a slight inward tilt toward the nasal bridge at the superior pole.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a significantly higher vertical to horizontal ratio.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shape across the posterior margin of the interscapular region.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, extending from the base of the neck to the mid-back, occupying approximately one-third of the visible torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide horizontal gap approximately twice the width of a single ear pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Consistent semicircular curvature with no visible flattening or irregularities at the apex.

other_distinctive_markers: The typically black regions of the pelage, specifically the periocular patches and ears, exhibit a distinct light brown or tan chromatic profile.
